scope: production Odoo session-cookie recovery only; no sale, inventory, purchase, refund, or register-close writes

checks.name: Orithos admin login
checks.evidence: Authenticated using the same-origin login API.

checks.name: Odoo service-account recovery is configured
checks.evidence: Production reports autoRecoverConfigured=true and an authenticated Odoo user.

checks.name: Odoo browser session cleared
checks.evidence: Same-origin session DELETE succeeded; this only clears the Odoo session cookie/session.

checks.name: First business page reconnects without manual Connect
checks.evidence: After clearing the Odoo cookie, replenishment loaded through its data API and returned to the normal page without a manual connect action.

checks.name: In-page read recovers and retries safely
checks.evidence: With the products page already loaded, its read-only POST recovered an expired Odoo session and refreshed the catalogue without an error or manual reconnect.

checks.name: Odoo reconnects automatically after session removal
checks.evidence: Authenticated Odoo user restored; POS session orithos_store1/00004 remains opened.
